title: Owner and agent share the persistent remote guest Chrome window

requires.workspaceName: A disposable signed-in owner's v3 workspace with a selected agent connection

steps.expected: Have the agent use chrome-devtools to open a harmless local test form. Select Chrome in pi-web-ui and type a sentinel into that form. Have the agent read that sentinel from the same tab.
Open Chrome in a separate tab and close the first viewer. Reopen it and verify the same page and typed value. Using only test data, set a persistent cookie on the form origin.

Use the native terminal to confirm 2 vCPUs, 8 GiB guest allocation and loopback-only CDP and VNC listeners. Record guest memory and desktop RSS at idle. Stop and start the workspace. Navigate Chrome to the test origin and verify the persistent cookie.
Verify an old viewer URL and a different owner's session cannot open the viewer or its input socket. Confirm native pi-web-ui terminal input still works.
